facts.fact: 猫 Alastor 沿 Phil 的身体爬上她的肩头蹲伏。
facts.anchor: clambered up Phil’s body in an explosion of claws and speed

facts.fact: Jeffrey 从 Clarissa 手里拿过电击枪，走上前电击最前面的丧尸，没有效果，随即后退。
facts.anchor: Jeffrey plucked the taser out of Clarissa’s hand

facts.fact: Jeffrey 分派 Jane 去破坏 Anne Bredon 的银行账户。
facts.anchor: Jane, you will sabotage Anne Bredon’s bank account in the meantime

facts.fact: Phil 指示女孩们在她出门后堵门，把课桌堆到门后。
Phil 命 Alastor 趁她分散 Margot 注意力时溜下楼梯打探。
facts.anchor: Sneak past her while I’m distracting her, she ordered Alastor.

facts.fact: Margot 对 Phil 说，学校的防护法阵是她炸的，Anne Bredon 是她放进来的。
facts.anchor: I blew up the school’s wards and let Miss Bredon in.

facts.fact: Margot 接过 Phil 的话后沿走廊跑走。
Phil 开始走下通往地窖的楼梯。

relations.fact: Alastor 是 Phil 的恶魔使魔（demon familiar），对她自称 Mistress。
relations.anchor: lack of spontaneous offers of assistance from her demon familiar

relations.fact: Jeffrey（Mr Smithson）是这所学校的教师，Alice 说他知道反坦克武器放在哪里。
relations.anchor: Mr Smithson here is a teacher and knows where the anti-tank weaponry is

relations.fact: Phil 对 Margot 处于 in loco parentis（代行家长/监护人）的位置。
relations.anchor: Phil was in loco parentis to her

numbers.fact: Phil 说自己当教师才一个多月：“a month and a bit”。
numbers.anchor: I’ve only been a teacher for a month and a bit

numbers.fact: 学校有四道较小的门：“four lesser doors”。
numbers.anchor: There were four lesser doors to the school

numbers.fact: Alastor 说 Anne Bredon 从正门进攻“三次”：“not once, not twice, but three times running”。
numbers.anchor: not once, not twice, but three times running
